description: Recent visitors to China’s tech zone in Shenzhen have come away in awe of the country’s manufacturing capabilities, including its increasingly advanced humanoid robots. And when iRobot’s Chinese supplier took over the company this year, it looked like another win for Chinese tech. Christopher Mims is a tech reporter for the Wall Street Journal. He’s the author of “Arriving Today: From Factory to Front Door – Why Everything Has Changed About How and What We Buy.” He joins David to discuss robots,…
classificationReason: The episode directly discusses humanoid robots, robotics manufacturing, AI, and iRobot’s Chinese supplier.
qualityReason: Features a technology reporter in an extended discussion of robotics and industry developments.
